title: Attack-Resistant Uniform Fairness for Linear and Smooth Contextual Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2602.04125v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern digital platforms use contextual bandits to allocate valuable exposure and opportunities among competing participants. Fair treatment is therefore an important concern, yet reward maximization alone does not ensure that preferential allocation reflects participants' merits. We develop algorithms for linear and smooth contextual bandits under uniform merit-based fairness, requiring the reward ordering to justify preferential allocation across all contexts and rounds, and study how these guarantees are affected by adversarial reward corruption. Our algorithms achieve \((1-\widetilde O(1/T))\)-fairness, with regret that is minimax optimal among fair policies for linear rewards and nearly minimax optimal for smooth rewards. In the linear setting, matching lower bounds identify the price of fairness exactly: minimax regret increases from \(\log T\) to \(\log^2 T\). For smooth rewards, the cost of fairness is at most polylogar

translated_title: 线性与平滑上下文老虎机的抗攻击统一公平性
translated_abstract: 现代数字平台使用上下文老虎机在竞争参与者之间分配宝贵的曝光机会和资源，因此公平对待成为一个重要关注点，然而仅靠奖励最大化并不能确保优先分配真正反映参与者的自身价值。我们针对线性和平滑上下文老虎机，在统一基于价值的公平性要求下（即奖励排序须在所有上下文和所有轮次中都能证明优先分配的合理性）开发了相应算法，并研究了这些公平性保证在对抗性奖励污染下的表现。我们的算法实现了 (1-Õ(1/T)) 级别的公平性，其遗憾值在线性奖励下达到公平策略中的极小极大最优，在平滑奖励下接近极小极大最优。在线性情形中，匹配的下界精确刻画了公平的代价：极小极大遗憾从 log T 增加到 log² T。对于平滑奖励，公平的代价至多为多对数级别。
tldr: 该论文提出了在线性与平滑上下文老虎机中抵御对抗性奖励污染的统一基于价值公平性算法，实现了近极小极大最优的遗憾值，并精确刻画了公平的代价（线性情形下遗憾从 log T 升至 log² T）。
en_tdlr: This paper develops attack-resistant algorithms for uniform merit-based fairness in linear and smooth contextual bandits, achieving (near-)minimax optimal regret among fair policies and exactly characterizing the price of fairness (regret increases from log T to log² T in the linear setting).
